decisions.reason: As a newly launched automation product that builds directly on the firm’s established offer and stated push toward smarter automation and digital production, management is likely to continue backing it and explain any early weakness as normal market ramp-up.

Because this dual-table loading system also extends the core machining automation business in a growing industry and has only just been introduced, the firm is likely to persist rather than reverse course after recent investment and public introduction.

Although this industrial dispensing machine is more distant from the established portfolio, the firm has invested enough to give it a dedicated page and publicize its Red Dot award, which makes management more likely to justify continued commitment than to withdraw it quickly.
